rubrics.justification: The response over-interprets a low-detail static image, asserting blebs, vacuolation, apoptosis, and likely regrading to 3BB or lower without clear visual support. It notes partial collapse/irregularity, which is plausible, but overall morphology assessment is more speculative than image-grounded.
It integrates age, BMI, AMH, PCOS, prior ectopic, endometrium, and semen data into prognosis reasonably well, though some links are overstated and not all factors directly modify embryo quality.

The structure is logical and the probability estimate follows its stated assumptions, but several deductions rely on speculative morphology and somewhat exaggerated penalty adjustments, reducing overall coherence.

Many recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice (smoking cessation, ectopic surveillance, OHSS/freeze-all consideration in PCOS), but ERA suggestion, routine second-opinion regrading from this image, and some strong claims about morphology/receptivity are not strongly guideline-based.

The response gives clear practical next steps for transfer monitoring, smoking cessation, and future cycle planning. Some recommendations are useful and specific, though a few are more aggressive than necessary for this case.
